sections.title: Social Studies in the Elementary and Middle Schools
sections.description: This course will focus on teaching and learning in the content area of social studies. Curricular and pedagogical theories and practices will be examined for their educational significance, meaningful integration of content areas, respect for students' cultures (past and present), and contribution to social justice issues. Offered within the Urban Teaching Apprenticeship Program.
